description: Personal data is not kept accurate and up to date. Controllers must take reasonable steps to ensure inaccurate data is erased or rectified without delay.
applicability: Applicable to all personal data storage and processing systems. Includes customer databases, HR systems, CRM platforms, and any system maintaining personal data records.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through data quality audits, duplicate detection, and review of data update processes. Assess whether mechanisms exist for data subjects to correct their data.
